meta.note: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker
meta.about: Words the English course (companion/course/en) uses that no English or Lakeland pack means, so its printed sheets list every word with its meaning in the learner's language and the word lookup finds them on the phone, which has no English Wiktionary: the course's words of A1 (fine, innkeeper, have got, the number words), each with the forms the course uses and their meaning in Slovene, German and Italian (meanings), written for a grown-up learner, not copied from a dictionary. British English; an American spelling is a form of its British lemma. Each part of the course appends its own words (docs/plans/05-built/course-en-a1-a.md). The Lake District's newer stories and readings (stories-lakeland) append the words of their tales and readings: the places and names (Mardale, Seathwaite, the Armada), the tales' nouns and verbs with the forms they use, and the past forms of the course's verbs (came, made, bought).
